answer: Clone fleets fail a height census because two keys cannot share one zenith mark. The claimant escrows 2.41 POA, then occupies a single survey bridge for 8 hours and presses an umber load-cell stamp (28 random bytes plus height) every 16 minutes. Five unaffiliated inspectors re-hash the trail; a reused stamp, a gap over 22 minutes, or a second mark on the same span slashes 0.67 POA and keeps the bridge closed for eight epochs. Clerks recompute every stamp from the public log, so copied zenith marks cannot multiply payouts.
